contributes.values:
experimental:
  plugins:
    # Downloaded from plugins.traefik.io at start.
    crowdsec-bouncer:
      moduleName: github.com/maxlerebourg/crowdsec-bouncer-traefik-plugin
      version: v1.8.1
ports:
  web:
    http:
      # Every request passes the bouncer; no app opts in.
      middlewares: [crowdsec-bouncer@kubernetescrd]
  websecure:
    http:
      # Same as web.
      middlewares: [crowdsec-bouncer@kubernetescrd]
accessLog:
  fields:
    names:
      # CrowdSec's scenarios key on the client address.
      ClientHost: keep
    headers:
      names:
        # Bot scenarios match on the user agent.
        User-Agent: keep

inputs.description: The Traefik bouncer uses this key to call the CrowdSec local API.
inputs.name: bouncerKey

inputs.description: The local API (LAPI) signs agent sessions with this shared secret.
inputs.name: lapiSecret

inputs.description: The chart's LAPI reads this token. Auto-registration is off, so nothing uses it.
inputs.name: registrationToken

metadata.name: CrowdSec
metadata.summary: Blocks brute-force attempts and scanners before they reach your services.

releases.name: ca
crowdsec
releases.values:
# Pinned by digest; a tag alone can move.
image:
  repository: crowdsecurity/crowdsec
  tag: v1.8.2@sha256:65b74942f7e7ed5c60fde4ac15fc4ba715904c398c8b16dd451f4907d90347d4
# The runtime on k3s and mainstream distributions.
container_runtime: containerd
tls:
  # Agents sign in with a cert-manager client certificate instead of
  # registering a machine name, which a restarted Pod would reuse
  # (crowdsecurity/helm-charts#252).
  enabled: true
  certManager:
    # The ca release.
    issuerRef: {name: crowdsec-ca, kind: Issuer}
    # Ten years: CrowdSec agents load their client certificate once
    # and never reload it (crowdsecurity/crowdsec#2810). Shorten this
    # once they do.
    duration: 87600h
    renewBefore: 720h
    secretTemplate:
      # The chart writes an empty secretTemplate without one, which
      # fails schema validation.
      labels: {app.kubernetes.io/part-of: crowdsec}
config:
  # Replaces the chart's default, which turns on token registration.
  # Merged into the image's config.yaml, which keeps its flush max_items
  # and max_age.
  config.yaml.local: |
    db_config:
      flush:
        agents_autodelete:
          # Deletes the machine a restarted agent leaves behind.
          cert: 7d
secrets:
  externalSecret:
    # Inputs, not chart-generated, so every render is identical.
    name: crowdsec-lapi
agent:
  wait_for_lapi:
    image:
      # The agent's image has nc; the chart's busybox has no digest.
      repository: crowdsecurity/crowdsec
      tag: v1.8.2@sha256:65b74942f7e7ed5c60fde4ac15fc4ba715904c398c8b16dd451f4907d90347d4
  acquisition:
    # Traefik's JSON access log.
    - namespace: traefik
      podName: traefik-*
      program: traefik
  env:
    # Parsers and scenarios for Traefik plus generic HTTP attacks.
    - name: COLLECTIONS
      value: crowdsecurity/traefik
lapi:
  env:
    # No data leaves the cluster unless the user opts in.
    - name: DISABLE_ONLINE_API
      value: "true"
    # Registers the Traefik bouncer (input bouncerKey).
    - name: BOUNCER_KEY_traefik
      valueFrom:
        secretKeyRef: {name: crowdsec-bouncer-key, key: key}
  persistentVolume:
    data:
      # SQLite decisions and bouncer registrations.
      enabled: true
    config:
      # Agents sign in with certificates, and a kept credentials file with a login would clash.
      enabled: false

releases.manifests:
# Referenced from Traefik's entrypoints as crowdsec-bouncer@kubernetescrd.
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: Middleware
metadata:
  name: bouncer
  namespace: crowdsec
spec:
  plugin:
    crowdsec-bouncer:
      enabled: true
      # Local copy of decisions; requests never wait on LAPI.
      crowdsecMode: stream
      crowdsecLapiScheme: https
      crowdsecLapiHost: crowdsec-service.crowdsec.svc.cluster.local:8080
      # The CA from the ca release, which signs the LAPI certificate.
      crowdsecLapiTlsCertificateAuthority: urn:k8s:secret:crowdsec-lapi-tls:ca.crt
      # Read from the Secret in the Middleware's namespace.
      crowdsecLapiKey: urn:k8s:secret:crowdsec-bouncer-key:key
      # Fail open: if LAPI is unreachable, keep serving traffic.
      updateMaxFailure: -1
releases.name: bouncer-middleware

security.summary: The agent reads node log files read-only. Its certificate gives a machine's rights to send and read alerts and to delete decisions.

smoke.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: catalog-smoke
  labels: {pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: privileged}
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: {name: agent-restart, namespace: catalog-smoke}
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 420
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      hostPID: true
      containers:
        - name: restart
          image: crowdsecurity/crowdsec:v1.8.2@sha256:65b74942f7e7ed5c60fde4ac15fc4ba715904c398c8b16dd451f4907d90347d4
          securityContext: {privileged: true, runAsUser: 0}
          command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - |
              # The agent's crowdsec process; the LAPI's has no DISABLE_LOCAL_API.
              agent() {
                for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do
                  [ "$(cat $p/comm 2>/dev/null)" = crowdsec ] || continue
                  if tr '\0' '\n' < $p/environ 2>/dev/null | grep -qx DISABLE_LOCAL_API=true; then
                    echo ${p#/proc/}
                    return
                  fi
                done
              }
              until old=$(agent) && [ -n "$old" ]; do sleep 5; done
              net=$(readlink /proc/$old/ns/net)
              for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do
                if [ "$(cat $p/comm 2>/dev/null)" = pause ] && [ "$(readlink $p/ns/net)" = "$net" ]; then
                  echo "killing the sandbox of pid $old"
                  kill -KILL ${p#/proc/}
                fi
              done
              until new=$(agent) && [ -n "$new" ] && [ "$(readlink /proc/$new/ns/net)" != "$net" ]; do sleep 5; done
              echo "agent runs again as pid $new"
smoke.name: agent-restarts
